# 04 — Chrysanthemum

## What It Is [HARD CANON]

Chrysanthemum is intentional semantic access to the Foam. The hardware is drafted and detailed in `meta/lexicon` §V (bioreactive core, milky pink nutrient medium, optical nerves veined with blue filament, copper clamps, diagnostic glass) — that physical description is unchanged and authoritative.

**It must remain esoteric.** It is not merely: code, prompting, an API, a semantic parser, graph manipulation, or AI. Those things can *scaffold* Chrysanthemum — there can be software, diagnostics, interfaces, visualizations, models, AI assistance, and institutional tooling around it. They are not Chrysanthemum itself.

A practitioner introduces intentional *meaning* into the relational substrate. Words can participate. Images can participate. Memory can participate. Association can participate. Emotion and conceptual composition may participate. **But words are not spells. Meaning is what matters.** The Chrysanthemum gives deliberate consciousness access to a process ordinary consciousness already participates in unconsciously (see `02_ontology.md` §The Float). This is why the technology cannot be reduced to syntax, and no future manuscript passage should present a correction as reducible to entering the correct string.

## Surface Mode and Full Emergence [HARD CANON — unchanged from `meta/lexicon`]

- **Surface mode**: the operator navigates the Float's correction architecture from outside, retaining continuous individual selfhood. Influence is real but bounded. Most licensed correction work happens here.
- **Full emergence**: contact-band interface plus intravenous Velanthin. The operator's individual self temporarily dissolves into the Foam; the boundary between observer and observed collapses; causality becomes spatially navigable; a sufficiently skilled operator can perceive a process's entire temporal cross-section simultaneously rather than sequentially. Full emergence fragments most operators (multiple personality presentations, vegetative dissociation, a class of survivors technically continuous but no longer convinced their functioning is theirs). Those who navigate it cleanly are rare, professionally invaluable, and — per `meta/characters` — includes B specifically because he has never been fully convinced the individual is a clean category; the Foam does not require him to surrender a conviction he already held provisionally.

Full detail, including Velanthin's regulatory classification (Schedule-A, Class Three Devolution credential, ninety-day renewal): `meta/lexicon` §V, unchanged.

## Chrysanthemum Practice Is an Art [HARD CANON — this is the section that most changes the practical texture of correction scenes]

Do not model Chrysanthemum practice as precise, deterministic engineering. There are many competent practitioners and relatively few masters.

**A mediocre practitioner sees:**

> Thomas → Company → Employment → Remove.

**A master perceives:**

- what Thomas means to the company
- what the company means to Thomas
- which relationships were created through the work
- which became independently meaningful
- what memories depend on the employment relationship
- what habits and rituals grew from it
- what other people became because Thomas was there
- which downstream structures will survive
- which will collapse
- where unresolved pressure will move
- what can safely remain
- what belongs to the larger whole

This connects directly to `meta_themes.md` §Aesthetics — a master does not merely know how to cut. A master understands the composition.

**Most institutional correction is relatively blunt**, because institutions need corrections to be repeatable, affordable, fast, administratively defensible, scalable, and standardized enough to deploy at volume. Most practitioners therefore remove large enough relational chunks to satisfy the immediate requirement — this is one direct cause of downstream harm and correction debt (`meta_correction.md` §Correction Debt).

**The technology requires artistry. The bureaucracy industrialized it.** This tension should remain visible wherever institutional correction work is shown at scale versus the individual, careful work a master practitioner (or B) performs. B and Noor are established as unusually skilled Devs (`meta/lexicon` §V); this section gives that skill concrete content — it is not raw power, it is relational perception.

## Do Not Over-Quantify [NARRATIVE INTENT — guardrail]

Do not introduce a numeric skill rating, a percentage of "relational damage avoided," or any formula converting practitioner ability into a measurable output. Practitioner skill should be shown through what a scene demonstrates a character noticing, not through a stated competence score.
